description: Expressive Island — refined island interactions, smarter assistant controls, and a more polished settings experience
features: Added expanded battery information with detailed battery status and charging information
Added system event support for more device states and system actions
Added notification timestamps, full notification text, source app labels, and notification testing options
Added configurable notification behaviour for silent notifications, DND, and notification alerts
Added dynamic color controls for system events and notification appearance, including per-app fallback colors
Added Shizuku integration with status-bar, system-alert, and permission controls
Added page transition options, haptic feedback controls, Split Island behaviour, and configurable satellite positioning
Added notification dismissal controls and improved event appearance controls
Added a camera-cutout activity ring for media playback and ongoing progress, including configurable appearance, size, opacity, and colors
Added seekable music progress controls with support for circular progress interaction
Added assistant response display in the cutout with configurable collapsed and expanded timeouts
Added persistent assistant timeout preferences with settings export and import support
Added searchable language selection in a bottom sheet and Hindi and Marathi translations across Profile and Settings
Added a new Expressive Island app identity and updated project branding
Improved the Apps settings layout with consistent horizontal spacing and vertically aligned search and filter controls
Improved the Events, Behaviour, Animation, Shizuku, Dynamic Tiles, and Profile settings screens with clearer organization and localized text
Improved music playback progress accuracy, seeking behaviour, and progress recovery after pausing
Improved camera-ring positioning and transition behaviour so the ring remains centered on the physical cutout
Improved assistant response handling so completed responses automatically dismiss instead of remaining visible indefinitely
bugfixes: Fixed duplicate satellite rendering between music and timer dynamic tiles
Fixed album artwork recovery after the MediaSession listener is rebound
Fixed custom expanded height being incorrectly applied to the expanded music player
Fixed notification display options and various Dynamic Island interaction issues
Fixed satellite ring color resolution, initial preference state, and restoration of normal indicators when the ring is disabled
Fixed assistant timeout compilation by avoiding unsafe smart casts of delegated properties
Fixed Apps settings search and filter alignment and restored consistent page spacing
Fixed the Shizuku back-pill title and appearance-effect corner grouping
Fixed settings layout changes leaking into screens outside the Apps page
